title: Book 1: Sanctuary on Caelum-IV (Movement IV — Stardate 49601)
description: Having reached escape velocity and crossed 1,200 light-years through the FTL Harmonic Continuum, the crew of the U.S.S. Aethelgard sets down on Caelum-IV ('Sanctuary')—the 0.88G outer rocky moon of the ringed gas giant Vespera (Kepler-442c) in a 48-hour tidally locked orbit. Retiring Earth's calendar for Stardate 49601.0, the family verifies the breathable atmosphere, purple halobacterial ocean, singing lava-tubes, warm 82°F rainstorms, Syzygy glass reefs, and Mother-Grove Amphitheater (where they record Starfield Calibration), and job-shadows Holly through a full day as Band Manager and Mission Commander.
